svg.title: Detailed AgriPV simulation integration
svg.desc: Detailed repository workflow from STICS input through Archicrop, scene construction, ArchimedLight and PlantBioPhysics to daily or yearly CSV and scene recipe outputs.
svg.text: Repository scripts, exchanged data and generated simulation outputs

g.text: Reads dated OBJ / MTG plant maquettes
Adds PV configuration and planting layout
Combines plants, panels and ground grid
One scene per day per PV configuration
e.g. phytomer count and plant height
